verdict.rationale: Insomnia explicitly offers a 'Scratch Pad' mode with no login ever required, and projects can be stored via 'Local Vault' instead of Cloud Sync or Git Sync, enabling a fully local, account-free workspace. Git Sync also keeps data entirely in the user's own repo without touching Insomnia's cloud. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the offline experience and any caveats about feature parity (e.g., AI features, mock servers) when working fully offline.
